rules.name: Native Technologies Only
rules.description: Use C++20 standard library, Windows SDK, and Microsoft-provided development tools (vcpkg, MSVC, CppUnitTest). nlohmann/json is an explicitly allowed third-party public dependency through vcpkg. Native Win32 scaffolds use public Windows view factory contracts; a complete WinUI renderer is not supplied. No new runtime dependencies without a reviewed policy change.

rules.name: Sealed Framework
rules.description: ForsettiCore, ForsettiPlatform, and ForsettiHostTemplate are sealed framework libraries. Consumers use public headers only. No subclassing framework classes unless explicitly designed for extension.

rules.name: No Internal Patching
rules.description: Never modify internal implementation files of the framework libraries. Extend functionality through public interfaces (abstract base classes) only.

rules.name: Public APIs Only
rules.description: Modules interact with the framework exclusively through published interfaces (abstract base classes in include/ headers).

rules.name: Strict OOP
rules.description: Interface-first design (abstract base classes with pure virtuals). Constructor dependency injection — no hidden globals. All classes must be 'final' unless extension is intentional and documented.

rules.name: One-Way Dependencies
rules.description: ForsettiCore depends on nothing. ForsettiPlatform depends on Core. ForsettiHostTemplate depends on Core and Platform. Example modules depend on Core only and not on each other. Samples may compose public targets. No reverse or lateral imports.

rules.name: Run Verification
rules.description: Before opening a PR, run Scripts/verify-forsetti-guardrails.ps1. The wrapper executes CMake configure/build, CTest, architecture and dependency checks, manifest validation, pull request compatibility checks, and script regression tests.

rules.name: Dual Licensing
rules.description: Retain Copyright James Daley 2026 in source files. The root LICENSE contains the authoritative dual-license terms. Non-commercial, academic, and personal use is free. Commercial use requires a separate written license.

rules.name: CI Build Parity
rules.description: No hosted workflow files are present in this checkout. Run Scripts/verify-forsetti-guardrails.ps1 locally for build, test, and guardrail evidence; SDK consumers also require the local archive verification commands. Hosted build/test enforcement requires separately authorized workflow setup and verified execution.

rules.name: Installed Consumer Boundary
rules.description: Follow CONSUMPTION_POLICY.md: do not copy/vendor/embed the framework development repository, recreate its runtime source targets, or patch SDK/dependency internals for application behavior. Consumers use installed Forsetti:: products and their SDK-owned public headers, declared dependencies, and approved app-owned scaffold outputs. Required licenses/notices remain permitted; these integration rules do not amend LICENSE.

framework_behavior_invariants: UI and app modules share a single active UI/app surface slot
Service modules may run concurrently without limit
Module activation requires passing compatibility check AND entitlement check
UIThemeMask capability is limited to declared, policy-approved UI theme IDs; framework host chrome remains framework-owned
Module communication guard blocks: empty IDs, self-messaging, forsetti.internal.* namespace
UISurfaceManager accepts validated module UI contributions and preserves declared theme masks
